args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Warehouse automation in 2026 (article + companion summary)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.

Source: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" (https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/warehouse) and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/warehouse/companion).
